source_interpretation.text: The authors adapt an earlier two-flask synthesis and vary injection temperature, growth temperature and time to tune the first exciton. Oleic acid is the reported capping ligand. The source does not provide a calibrated process-to-diameter map or a complete ligand-speciation model.

The authors interpret the small Stokes shift and high relative quantum yield as evidence of efficient surface passivation and limited trapping. They qualify the quantum-yield calibration because grating efficiency was not corrected; the historical 85% estimate is not a new absolute measurement.

An effective-mass model, confinement-energy ratios and intraband spectra jointly motivate the authors’ transition assignments. The unexpectedly allowed second exciton and unresolved expected degeneracy remain open questions in this source. These are model interpretations, not atomistic structural measurements.
